from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashBalanceRecord(BaseModel):
    """A record of the beginning cash balance for a single company from a financial statement."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company in the financial report")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The specific label of the cash balance line item as written in the statement")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numerical value of the beginning cash balance")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scaling factor applied to the amount (e.g. 'dollars', 'thousands')")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The date range or period end date of the report")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_balance_records: list[CashBalanceRecord]
